Faction Profile: faction-profile-v1 kazrak-industries kazrak-industries Faction_System_Packet/factions/Corps_Touching_The_Oneshot.md strong True True undead Kazrak Industries Adventure, certification, glory, and dungeon work pitched like a chance to become legendary. Kazrak™: where legends are made! Kazrak Industries™ sells adventure itself: certifications, hero ratings, and the chance to die famous. Kazrak™ recruiting tents are pure hype: banners of grinning certified heroes, a barker bellowing about Glory Tier™ benefits, a try-before-you-die Sample Dungeon™ rated 'Tier 0, mostly survivable!' You can buy a Legend License™, a Hazard Heritage™ commemorative coin, and an upgrade to Premium Casualty Coverage™ that pays your next of kin in Kazrak store credit. The recruiter shakes your hand with both of his and calls you 'future legend' so many times it starts to sound like a verdict. The fine print rates your life by Content Value™: the more dangerously you die, the more your story is worth, to them. A Kazrak poster shows a smiling hero standing on a pile of treasure no worker could lift alone. The paint is flaking at the edges, but the grin remains perfect. Kazrak Industries Kazrak Industries...
